notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla implements solo looting (CMSG_LOOT/AUTOSTORE_LOOT_ITEM/LOOT_MONEY/LOOT_RELEASE; SMSG_LOOT_RESPONSE both shapes, LOOT_REMOVED, LOOT_CLEAR_MONEY, LOOT_RELEASE_RESPONSE, LOOT_MONEY_NOTIFY, ITEM_PUSH_RESULT) plus the group-roll family. MSUI fully implements the solo family and CMSG_LOOT_METHOD, but has no group-roll support at all.

notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGE FINDING: Master loot (CMSG_LOOT_MASTER_GIVE / SMSG_LOOT_MASTER_LIST) is explicitly out of scope in Benilla itself (loot.rs header), so the pre-pass entries for those two are not MSUI gaps.
